figurative_meaning_en: Pride in one's wealth; elaborate pomp or grandeur
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বিয়েতে জাঁকজমক করে সবাইকে আমন্ত্রণ করেছে।
ঐশ্বর্য দেখানোর জন্য সে জাঁকজমক করে বাড়ি সাজিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The wedding was arranged with great pomp and show to impress everyone.
He decorated his house with elaborate pomp to flaunt his wealth.
note: This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking sounds of grandeur; commonly used in Bengali literature to describe ostentatious displays.
